adoption.note: Loot Goblins existed before the Factory and was adopted into Factory 0.1.0; it was not generated from the starter. createdAt is null for that reason.

customized.note: Informational only. The Factory 0.1 updater does not read this list and does not protect these files; review each one by hand before any migration changes it.

files.AGENTS.md: Loot Goblins team policy: open scope, merge when the requesting teammate is happy, stacked PRs, Git done for teammates who do not use it. No PROTOTYPE_TEST gate and no phone/touch rule yet.
files.default.project.json: Rojo project name LootGoblinsTest001 and Workspace streaming settings.
files.test.project.json: Rojo project name LootGoblinsTest001 and Workspace streaming settings.
files.scripts/play.ps1: Prints 'Press H' only; the game has no ? help button.
files..github/workflows/check.yml: Runs on pull requests to any base branch, so stacked PRs are checked.
files.docs/WORKSTATION.md: Loot Goblins names, three-player test checklist, and extra troubleshooting entries.
files.docs/PROTOTYPE_TEST.md: Deliberately absent: the game is past its prototype gate.
files.tests/luau/Specs/UtilSpec.lua: Deliberately absent: the game has its own specs and its own Util.lua.
